test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 11 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill blank 3.
solution:
The correct answer is 'emergence'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• Let's take a look at the phrase: The growing (3) ______ of epidemics and pandemics
 
• Let's take a look at the meaning of the given options:
 
 
• wane: (of the moon) have a progressively smaller part of its visible surface illuminated, so that it appears to decrease in size.
 
• dissolution: disintegration; decomposition.
 
• emergence: the process of coming into being, or of becoming important or prominent.
 
• need: expressing necessity or obligation.
 
 
 
• Thus, from above, we can say that the correct answer is option 3.
